invariants.description: volume balance: d(q)/dt = (v) - (v_T) (trapezoidal integral of the flows from t = 0 s, rel. tol 0.005)

invariants.expr: np.max(np.abs((u) - ((q - q_us)/C_T + u_ext))) <= 1e-08*(np.max(np.abs(u)) + np.max(np.abs((q - q_us)/C_T + u_ext))) + 1e-30

invariants.description: steady state at t_end: v = v_T = (u_in - u_out)/R_total, R_total = (R_T1 + R_T2 + Delta_R)*R_local_multiplier
invariants.expr: np.all(np.abs(np.array([v[-1], v_T[-1]]) - (u_in - u_out)/((R_T1 + R_T2 + Delta_R)*R_local_multiplier)) <= 1e-3*(abs(u_in - u_out)/((R_T1 + R_T2 + Delta_R)*R_local_multiplier) + np.max(np.abs(v_T))) + 1e-18)

invariants.description: steady state at t_end: u = u_in - R_1 v, R_1 = (R_T1 + Delta_R*R_T1/(R_T1 + R_T2))*R_local_multiplier
invariants.expr: abs((u)[-1] - (u_in - ((R_T1 + Delta_R*R_T1/(R_T1 + R_T2))*R_local_multiplier)*(u_in - u_out)/((R_T1 + R_T2 + Delta_R)*R_local_multiplier))) <= 0.001*(abs(u_in) + abs(u_out) + 1.0 + np.max(np.abs(u))) + 1e-18

bc_sweep.rationale: Boundary conditions span physiological operating values for the vessel class (arterial inlet 60-150 mmHg, venous 0-15 mmHg, flows 0-2x the nominal flow; +-0.5% for the nonlinear vv types, whose volume drifts by (v_in - v_out) t and collapses the tube if the imbalance is larger); constants are swept 0.5-2x their value; rho and mu are swept 0.5-2x their library (test_fft fixture) value of 1; beta_g 0-1; g 1-9.81; the wall-thickness constants a-d between the fixture value 1 and the proposed Blanco 2015 values. The physiological rho/mu (1050, 0.004) cannot yet be combined with the others at the run point (framework issue), so the swept regime is the library one. Excluded: tube-law exponents (they define the law), switches (R_flag, blood_ctl_dir).

baseline.reason: a single vessel under constant boundary conditions has no measured counterpart; validation needs a network assembled from these modules. Candidate: fitted three-element Windkessel values and input impedance of the systemic circulation (e.g. Stergiopulos et al. 1999) (proposal only, not set up).
